parole.significato: A horseman or cavalryman, especially a German one, associated with the wars of the 16th and 17th centuries.
parole.testo: From Middle Dutch ruter, rutter, variants of ruiter, from Middle French routier (“mercenary soldier”), corresponding to route + ier; see rout.
